symptom: `use building block PlatformDesignSystem.Icon_After_Text` (also Wizard_Horizontal_Responsive, Wizard_Mobile, Wizard_Vertical) failed with `failed to build widget: dynamictext "b_text13": an inline `style` crashes MxBuild — wrap it in a container and style the container instead` — the block's own text carries Style '--icon-size: auto;'
cause: The MDL-WIDGET03 guard in applyWidgetAppearance (#673) refuses any dynamictext with a style. A block is expanded by rendering its stored widgets to MDL and re-parsing them, so the block's Studio Pro-authored style reached the guard indistinguishable from hand-written MDL
fix: The expander marks every widget it copies in (FromBuildingBlock, carried by cloneWidget's struct copy); the guard skips marked widgets, so the block's stored style is written verbatim. Hand-written MDL is still refused (check and exec)
insight: Measured on Mendix 11.12.1 with real mxbuild: a dynamic text with an inline style written by the current modelsdk engine — hand-written via --no-check with the guard stubbed, and via a patched Card block — passes mx check with 0 errors and `mxcli docker build` (BUILD SUCCEEDED); testdata/testapp also has a Studio Pro-authored dynamic text styled 'word-wrap: break-word;'. The #673 crash did not reproduce, so the hand-written refusal may be obsolete (it predates the modelsdk engine); not lifted here. Any guard written for authored MDL also fires on block/fragment expansion unless it knows the widget's origin
